highlights.title: Google Play Supporter & Patron Perks
highlights.description: Support development directly via Google Play and unlock the cosmetic Verified Patron emblem on share cards.

highlights.title: Theme Studio Color Picker
highlights.description: Interactive HSV color wheel, curated preset swatches, and hex input for customizing themes.

highlights.title: Multi-Line Lyrics Sharing
highlights.description: Select multiple synchronized lyric lines smoothly in Now Playing share mode without accidental dismissals.

highlights.title: Dynamic What's New System
highlights.description: View release highlights and feature announcements directly inside the app with offline caching.

highlights.title: MFAudioCore Engine Hardening
highlights.description: Added watchdog auto-recovery for zero-transfer stalls and enhanced thread lifecycle synchronization.

highlights.title: USB DAC Detach & Kernel Reconnect
highlights.description: Virtual USB DAC detach/attach handling with automatic kernel audio reconnect.

highlights.title: Listening Recap Studio
highlights.description: Analyze your sonic persona, top artists, and top genres with shareable story cards.

highlights.title: Playback Control Widgets
highlights.description: Enhanced home screen widgets with real-time playback synchronization and track actions.

highlights.title: Track Sorting & Library Refinements
highlights.description: Refined track list sorting orders, fast indexing, and improved metadata scanning.
